rows.text: calls `0031E860` + 0x4 and returns its result when it is null; otherwise tail-jumps (`0031E860` + 0x1A) with `rcx` = that result

notes: 0031E860 is also reached by jmp from 00303E90 + 0x15 and 00313590 + 0x15. The incoming rcx is not set before the first call, so whatever the caller passed is forwarded unchanged.
